planets.name: HAT-P-18 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-18 with a 5.51-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-18 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-18. Its orbit and size follow Yee & Vissapragada 2026's fit, the archive's default.
